summary.en: While on a walk, Conan, Ran, and Kogoro heard a gunshot from a house in Kamakura. While heading to investigate, Kogoro was unable to catch a masked man that runs past them. Conan finds a dead man with dried blood and white powdery substance on his shirt. Location: Hisaemon Yaguchi's house Victim: Hisaemon Yaguchi Cause of death: Gunshot wound on Chest Suspects: Rokuro Yaguchi, Akihiko Yaguchi, and Kimio Yaguchi The victim dead from the Winchester Model 37A Single Barreled Shotgun. The man, Hisaemon Yaguchi, is revealed to have died hours ago and his three sons are the suspects to the murder.
